name: PlexAnnouncer
description: A Discord bot that sends updates about your plex media to a Discord channel using webhooks. Please see the support thread for more details on how to set it up and configure Discord and Plex.

ports.name: Webhook Port
ports.description: The port for incoming webhooks from Plex, it must match the port specified in the webhook url in your plex settings.

variables.name: Plex Server URL
variables.description: The url pointing to your Plex server, you can obtain it from the external url of one of your Plex server libraries.

variables.name: Plex Webhook Token
variables.description: Some randomly generated token, you can put anything alphanumeric in here.

variables.name: Discord Webhook URL
variables.description: The url of your Discord webhook, retrieve it from your server webhook settings. A comma seperated list of urls is also possible.

variables.name: Updated Libraries
variables.description: List of libraries that will be checked for new media, if this is empty it checks all libraries.
